decision_rationale: The paper introduces CellWhisperer as a new multimodal model, not just an application wrapper, and includes a fine-tuned LLM that answers free-text questions and generates chat responses. It is trained on over a million transcriptome-text pairs and supports zero-shot annotation across broad human biology.
evidence_snippet: connects transcriptomes and text for interactive single-cell RNA-seq data analysis; fine-tuned the Mistral 7B open-source LLM to produce the matched answers; zero-shot manner and without the need for reference datasets; across a broad range of human biology; generates cell cluster captions and natural-language chats
